_comment: Research and data-protection approvals for using real Kenya Watch reports in the ML workspace. The live application does not read this file; the ML export and readiness gate do. Fill in each 'reference' with the actual document or email reference (an ethics approval number, a supervisor's letter, a DPO assessment). An entry with an empty reference is treated as NOT granted, because an approval nobody can point to is not evidence of approval.

approvals.name: Institutional ethics / research approval for using de-identified report narratives
approvals.scope: Secondary analysis of anonymised Kenya Watch report narratives for training and evaluating a category-suggestion model.
conditions: Only de-identified text may leave the operational database.
No reporter identity, tracking reference, access key, evidence file or precise date may be exported.
Findings are reported in aggregate; no individual report is quoted in the documentation.

approvals.name: Data-protection review of the intended processing (Data Protection Act, 2019)
approvals.scope: Purpose limitation, minimisation, retention and security for the research copy of report text.
conditions: The research copy is held separately from the live database and is not used for any enforcement decision.
Retention ends with the project; the derived model artefact is deleted on request.
Any change of purpose requires a fresh review.

sealed_test_set.policy: The supervisor holds a separately frozen set of adjudicated real reports that is never used for training or model selection. Only that set may be used to report real-world performance, so the reported figure cannot be inflated by tuning on the same data.
